checks.title: Drive Bare Hands by voice
checks.instructions: With Bare Hands enabled and the default continuous_brain architecture running, ask Jarvis out loud to activate Bare Hands, then to start calibration, then to exit. Watch runtime/trace.jsonl for the command and receipt events.
checks.expected: Each spoken request reaches the page and performs the same action as the equivalent button, commands that arrive late are refused rather than fired, and every command and refusal appears in the trace with a stable code.
